lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in a regular, rectangular grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits, forming at least five distinct horizontal rows extending across the visible lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a structured series of grid-based anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin's silhouette contains a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance circular blobs concentrated primarily towards the base and mid-section of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular notch or indentation is visible on the trailing (posterior) edge of the pectoral fin, indicating localized tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, yellow-tinted elongated clusters (consistent with commensal organisms) are visible attached to or swimming near the gill slits and the pectoral fin base.
